comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
Several plus and min sides of this ship.

PLUS:
- This ship CAN have EA, SMR and RSM as optional skill.
- Sail stats is the highest so far except against the Refitted version.
- Cargo is much lower, almost low as LLM. Suited for piracy/BHing.

MIN:
- Unlike LLM, this ship still lacks full base row power which means the bonus speed on row power is less when rowing skill is used.
- It is NOT suited for real maritime battles as it lacks base armour/dura greatly.
- The level requirement is pretty high for this NC ship, but at least it still can have 8 mods.

More info can be found at uwotool :-)
